title: Still Kicking — EN/IT/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar Italian Portuguese language learning warm baritone 104bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual resilience true story Australian family
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
November 2021. Coward punch.
Concussion. Neck surgery. Silver Chain every morning.
"You alive?" "Still kicking."
He will live. He always said so.

[Verse 2 - Italian, with English translations]
Novembre 2021. Pugno vigliacco. (November 2021. Coward punch.)
Commozione cerebrale. Chirurgia al collo. Silver Chain ogni mattina. (Concussion. Neck surgery. Silver Chain every morning.)
"Sei vivo?" "Sto ancora calciando." (You alive? Still kicking.)
Sopravviverà. Lo ha sempre detto. (He will live. He always said so.)
Andò da uno psicologo. (He went to see a psychologist.)
Lo disse in un messaggio. (He said that in a text.)
Al suo fratello. (To his brother.)
Un uomo che può farlo (A man who can do that)
Non viene sconfitto da un pugno vile. (Is not beaten by a coward punch.)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
Ainda chutando (Still kicking)
Ele respondeu isso quando perguntaram (He answered that when they asked)
Ainda chutando (Still kicking)
Do Brasil, Corey ligou (From Brazil, Corey called)
Ainda chutando (Still kicking)
Joel do outro lado da linha (Joel on the other end of the line)
Ainda chutando (Still kicking)
O pescoço está melhorando (The neck is coming good)
Ainda chutando (Still kicking)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Kerry is cancer free. And the family went on from there.
Italian: Kerry è libera dal cancro. E la famiglia è andata avanti da lì. (Kerry is cancer free. And the family went on from there.)
Portuguese: Kerry está livre do câncer. E a família continuou a partir daí. (Kerry is cancer free. And the family went on from there.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Still kicking — Joel Aaron McIvor — still kicking
Italian: Sto ancora calciando — Joel Aaron McIvor — ancora (Still kicking — Joel Aaron McIvor — still)
Portuguese: Ainda chutando — Joel Aaron McIvor — ainda (Still kicking — Joel Aaron McIvor — still)
